title: Ontology Consistency Spec
description: Alignment of Knowledge Records with graph ontology node/edge types. Specification only.

rules.statement: Foundational Concept records MUST map to node_type Concept.
Entity catalog records MUST map to Entity (or an approved Concept-as-entity-set documented in pack design).
Pack/Module MUST NOT be used as substitutes for Concept identity.
record_id bound to a Concept node is immutable (GRAPH-C-003).
Unknown node_type or edge_type values fail ontology consistency.
Example nodes SHOULD reference a parent Concept/Rule/Entity via REFERENCES or RELATED_TO.
